title: ConsentTensor
description: Cryptographically bound, time-scoped, prime-indexed consent record for PHI inference authorization within the AHGI governance lattice.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must match enforcing runtime version exactly.

prime_index.description: Prime number uniquely indexing this consent record in the PIRTM provenance chain. Must be a verified prime. Sequential primes assigned by the Consent Fabric registry. In the event of registry downtime, nodes draw from a pre-allocated offline pool.

subject_did.description: W3C DID of the data subject granting consent.

issuer_did.description: W3C DID of the entity issuing and attesting to this consent record. Must be a registered Consent Guardian agent.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of consent expiry. After this time, all inference gates must block. Null is not permitted — all consents are time-bounded.

scope.description: Explicit list of authorized inference operations. Each item is a scoped permission token.

resource_type.description: FHIR-aligned resource type the consent covers.

operations.description: Authorized operations on the resource type. Write is never permitted via consent tensor — it requires a separate clinical authorization chain (Clinical Authorization Tensor / CAT).

agent_classes.description: Agent classes authorized to operate under this scope item. Unlisted agent classes are hard-blocked regardless of other permissions.

field_restrictions.description: Optional FHIR path expressions restricting which fields within the resource type are accessible. Absence means all fields in the resource_type are permitted.

purpose_code.description: HL7 purpose of use code binding this scope item.

dp_policy.description: Differential privacy parameters binding aggregate operations under this consent.

mechanism.description: DP mechanism applied when this consent is used in aggregate or federated operations. 'none' only valid for treatment purpose with single-subject scope.

epsilon.description: Privacy budget epsilon. Values above 1.0 require explicit clinical justification in dp_justification field.

delta.description: Failure probability delta for approximate DP. Must be 0 for Laplace mechanism.

dp_justification.description: Required when epsilon > 1.0. Human-readable justification reviewed by Governance Judiciary.

revocation.description: Revocation binding. Consent is live only when status=active and registry confirms non-revocation.

registry_did.description: DID of the revocation registry. Must be a governance-registered registry endpoint.

revocation_list_index.description: Bit index in the W3C StatusList2021 or equivalent revocation list.

status.description: Current status. Runtime must re-verify against registry on every TTL cycle, not trust this field alone.

revoked_at.description: Populated by registry on revocation. Null if active.

coherence_binding.description: Mandatory binding of this consent to coherence gate parameters. Consent is suspended if R(t) falls below r_min_override.

r_min_override.description: Consent-specific coherence floor. Overrides system default R_min for this subject's sessions.

suspend_on_drift.description: If true, consent is automatically suspended when spectral drift exceeds drift_threshold.

drift_threshold.description: Cosine similarity delta above which spectral drift triggers consent suspension.

provenance.description: PIRTM provenance link. Chains this consent to its predecessor in the prime-indexed lineage.

parent_prime_index.description: Prime index of the immediately preceding consent record for this subject. 2 if this is the first consent.

lineage_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the parent consent tensor as anchored in Archivum. Enables offline chain verification without registry access.

archivum_anchor.description: Archivum registry anchor for this consent tensor's prime index.

archivum_record_id.description: Archivum's canonical record ID for prime_index assignment attestation.

archivum_did.description: DID of the Archivum registry instance. Must match governance-registered Archivum DID.

anchor_timestamp.description: Timestamp of Archivum anchoring. Consent tensor is not valid before this timestamp.

namespace.description: Archivum prime namespace. Prevents prime collision across AHGI record classes.

signature.description: Linked Data Proof binding the consent tensor to the issuer DID.

verification_method.description: DID URL of the issuer's verification key, e.g. did:key:z6Mk...#keys-1

proof_value.description: Base58-encoded or JWS-encoded signature over the canonical consent tensor (excluding this signature block).
